title: 第15章 看看内搭第16章 你在桥上看风景
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第15章看看内搭（..）天色已经完全黑了下来，周望站在套房客厅的落地窗前，听着轻柔的音乐，手里端着一杯香槟，俯视着明城的万家灯火，眼眸深沉。
他轻轻的呷了一口，随即就是一阵龇牙，“香槟都这么酸的吗？”
没怎么喝过起泡酒的周望一秒破功，也不再装什么上流社会了，果断关掉了音乐，把香槟一放，去冰箱里拎了瓶罗斯福10号的精酿，狠狠的灌了一口，这才畅快的往沙发上一靠。
“还是啤酒对味！”
香槟酒是Bella送来的酒店入住礼之一，冰箱里的饮料都是免费的，酒水则是收费的。
不过以周望现在的收入，喝这种酒店售价80块一瓶的精酿也就是洒洒水啦，毫无感觉。
他喝酒听音乐只是为了平息心底的那一点小躁动，原因来自于他从Bella口中得知的另外一部分入住特权。
除了可以免费使用会议室、健身区域之外，他还自动成为了酒店合作的高端SPA中心的VIP，享有最高折扣，且酒店还送了一张免费的体验券。
看着桌上的“小卡片”
，以及卡片上印着的若隐若现的美丽身影，从没体验过的周望很是神往。
按摩SPA嘛，先不管正规不正规，天然就能勾动男人心中的那根弦……
特别是他在短短一天的时间内，经历了这么多事，他全身的细胞都散发出了一种想要释放减压的欲望。
20岁出头的年纪，旺盛分泌的荷尔蒙，再加上周望久不食肉糜，当然会有些躁动。
失策的是，酒精好像只能起反作用，不仅没有压下去，反而让那团无名的火烧的更旺了。
“还有正事要做，还有正事要做……”
但周望最终还是凭借非人的毅力，忍住了现在就去体验一番的冲动，而是召唤出了系统界面，打开了书单，做起了接下来的阅读学习计划。
总共14天的时间，周望也不是很确定自己到底能读多少本书，他选择了最把稳的方式，那就是由易到难，如果后面阅读的速度加快了，那再临时调整。
最终，周望精心挑选出了20本书籍，虽然肯定不可能读完这么多，但只要能完成四分之一，得到至少200的积分值，就已经有了保底。
等周望删删改改完成了自制书单以后，时间已经来到了10点多。
打电话让Bella送来一份宵夜，坐在餐桌前的周望拿起了刚才被他静音的手机。

没有未接电话，短信倒是有好几条，但除了酒店恭贺入住的，其他都是推销短信。
这些推销短信还跟以前收到的不太一样，有证券公司发来的，也有搞二手奢侈品回收的……
周望见状不由摇头。
这年头的大数据之下，个人真是没有多少隐私，才一天不到的时间，他妈都不知道他发财了，各种牛鬼蛇神反而先跳出来了，而周望甚至都不能确定这些信息是从哪里泄露的。
点开微信，班级群里多了不少信息，周望扫了一眼，是一群在明城的同学正互相邀约着后天去参加丁一的生日宴。
他就住本地的那个舍友李晟还私聊问了他一句回没回靖城，要不要一起去。
想起那个笑容永远明媚的女孩，周望怔怔的发了一会呆，随即才回复了李晟。
“不了，最近有点忙，没时间。”
要说他对丁一真没有一点念想，那太过虚伪，毕竟曾经确确实实的心动过，也遗憾过。
周望不太喜欢什么“白月光”
这样的庸俗说法，直面内心的话，就是见色起意和……持续的见色起意。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book lovers: Wealth and Freedom Begins from Graduation Chapter 15 Take a look at the inner outfit (..) It was completely dark. Zhou Wang stood in front of the floor-to-ceiling window in the living room of the suite, listening to soft music, holding a glass of champagne in his hand, looking down at the lights of Mingcheng, with deep eyes.
He took a gentle sip and then bared his teeth, "Is champagne so sour?"
Zhou Wang, who had never drunk sparkling wine, broke through in a second and stopped pretending to be a high-class person. He turned off the music decisively, put the champagne on, went to the refrigerator and picked up a bottle of Roosevelt No. 10 craft beer, took a deep sip, and then leaned back on the sofa happily.
“It tastes better to beer!”
Champagne is one of the hotel check-in gifts from Bella. The drinks in the refrigerator are free, but the wine is charged.
However, with Zhou Wang's current income, drinking this kind of craft beer, which sells for 80 yuan a bottle in a hotel, is just water and has no feeling at all.
He drank and listened to music just to calm down the little restlessness in his heart. The reason came from another part of the stay privileges he learned from Bella.
In addition to being able to use the conference room and fitness area for free, he also automatically became a VIP of the high-end SPA center cooperated with the hotel, enjoying the highest discount, and the hotel also gave him a free experience coupon.
Look at the "little card" on the table
, and the looming and beautiful figure printed on the card, Zhou Wang, who had never experienced it before, was very fascinated.
Massage SPA, regardless of whether it is formal or not, can naturally touch the chord in a man's heart...
Especially since he had experienced so many things in just one day, all the cells in his body exuded a desire to release and relieve stress.
In his early 20s, with the strong secretion of hormones and the fact that Zhou Wang has not eaten minced meat for a long time, he will naturally be a little restless.
Unfortunately, the alcohol seemed to have the opposite effect. Instead of suppressing it, it actually made the unknown fire burn even brighter.
"There are still business matters to be done, there are still business matters to be done..."
But in the end, Zhou Wang relied on his inhuman perseverance to resist the urge to experience it now. Instead, he summoned the system interface, opened the book list, and started the next reading and study plan.
In a total of 14 days, Zhou Wang was not sure how many books he could read. He chose the most prudent method, which was to go from easy to difficult. If the reading speed speeds up later, he would make temporary adjustments.
In the end, Zhou Wang carefully selected 20 books. Although it was certainly impossible to read so many, as long as he could finish a quarter and get at least 200 points, he would have a guarantee.
After Zhou Wang completed deleting, deleting, and revising the self-made book list, it was already past 10 o'clock.
After calling Bella to deliver a midnight snack, Zhou Wang, who was sitting at the dining table, picked up the cell phone that he had just silenced.
There were no missed calls, but there were several text messages, but except for the one from the hotel congratulating me on my stay, the others were all promotional messages.
These promotional text messages are different from those I received before. Some are from securities companies, and some are engaged in recycling second-hand luxury goods...
Zhou Wang couldn't help but shake his head when he saw this.
With the big data these days, individuals really don't have much privacy. In less than a day, he didn't even know he was getting rich. Instead, all kinds of ghosts and ghosts jumped out first, and Zhou Wang couldn't even determine where the information was leaked from.
Clicking on WeChat, there were a lot of messages in the class group. Zhou Wang glanced at it and saw that it was a group of classmates in Mingcheng who were inviting each other to attend Ding Yi's birthday party the day after tomorrow.
Li Sheng, his local roommate, even asked him in private if he had returned to Jingcheng and if he wanted to go together.
Thinking of the girl who always had a bright smile, Zhou Wang was stunned for a while, and then replied to Li Sheng.
"No, I've been a little busy lately and don't have time."
To say that he doesn't miss Ding Yizhen at all, that is too hypocritical, after all, I have been truly heartbroken and regretful.
Zhou Wang doesn't like "White Moonlight" very much
Such a vulgar saying, if faced directly to the heart, is the desire to see color and... the continuous desire to see color.
